manage.title: Manage ACME certificates
manage.description: See the certificate status and request a new certificate now.

autoRenew.label: Renew automatically
autoRenew.description: Check twice a day and get a new certificate when there is none, it does not cover the domain, or it expires within 30 days.

domain.label: डोमेन
domain.description: प्रमाणपत्र के लिए सार्वजनिक डोमेन नाम।

email.label: ईमेल
email.description: Contact email for the ACME account and expiry notices.

provider.label: प्रमाणपत्र प्राधिकरण
provider.description: Where to get the certificate. Use staging to test without hitting Let's Encrypt rate limits.

directoryUrl.label: ACME directory URL
directoryUrl.description: Only for a custom certificate authority. Must be an https URL.

challengeType.label: Challenge type
challengeType.description: How to prove you own the domain.
challengeType.http: HTTP - needs port 80 reachable from the internet
challengeType.cloudflare: DNS (Cloudflare) - needs a Cloudflare API token

cloudflareToken.label: Cloudflare API token
cloudflareToken.description: आपके डोमेन के लिए Zone:DNS:Edit अनुमति वाला स्कोप्ड टोकन।

status.title: Certificate status
status.missing: Set the domain, email and the fields your challenge type needs, then save, before requesting a certificate.
status.requesting: प्रमाणपत्र अनुरोध किया जा रहा है...
